Class LinkedJobInfoList

java.lang.Object
QueueNet.LinkedJobInfoList
All Implemented Interfaces:
JobInfoList
Direct Known Subclasses:
PSJobInfoList
public class LinkedJobInfoList extends Object implements JobInfoList
This class implements a linked job info list.
Author:
Francesco Radaelli, Stefano Omini Modified by Ashanka (May 2010): Patch: Multi-Sink Perf. Index Description: Added new Performance index for capturing 1. global response time (ResponseTime per Sink) 2. global throughput (Throughput per Sink) each sink per class.
